items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: Was he any relation to Big Landry, the big fella, the big guy, you know?

ctx.x: Henry Landry. He's away from here, I think he's in California. He put it down after, you know, after the band broke up.
Was he any relation to Big Landry, the big fella, the big guy, you know?
